_about: Page layout for `csa system-diagram` and the Evidence Workspace System explorer. Per project: the data centres left to right (sites = the site values recorded against hosts that belong to it) and the band titles. IT goes across the top, shared services across the bottom. A project without an entry gets its two busiest sites as data centres. residency: which side of the IT/OT line a service provider sits, stated per project with the evidence for it (it_domains: domain controllers of these enterprise domains are IT-resident; ot_domains: members of these domains are OT-resident). A provider the rule does not cover is drawn as 'location not captured'.

tetra-reveloc.shared_label: Shared services: directory, DNS and time

residency.basis: E-021: DNS resolution depends on enterprise Active Directory-integrated DNS servers. E-066: the enterprise NTP sources are ROTPRDSRV122, MOTPRDSRV122 and IPTPRDSRV224. No OT domain exists yet (the OT domain is part of the migration).
